body.message:
Yes, the rates are fine and we will be providing you the unit for 6 months at the confirmed rate.

However, please note that the agreement will be on a monthly basis. To secure the arrangement, an advance payment for the last month will be required, which allows us to fully block the unit for your stay.

Kindly rest assured that your booking will be extended on a month-to-month basis, and we will issue the contract accordingly. The rate will remain the same as previously confirmed.

Thank you for your understanding.
